---
title: ""
format:
  revealjs:
    title-slide: false
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <style>
          .pinball-divider-art {
            position: relative;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            background:
              linear-gradient(142deg, transparent 48%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18) 48.3%, transparent 49%),
              linear-gradient(35deg, transparent 62%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) 62.3%, transparent 63%),
              #123a47;
          }

          .pinball-divider-art::before,
          .pinball-divider-art::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            border: 18px solid #f5c858;
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 7px #e2553f, 0 0 0 8px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
          }

          .pinball-divider-art::before {
            width: 108px;
            height: 108px;
            top: 21%;
            left: 23%;
          }

          .pinball-divider-art::after {
            width: 66px;
            height: 66px;
            right: 22%;
            bottom: 23%;
          }

          .pinball-divider-led {
            position: absolute;
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: #7dd8c7;
            box-shadow: 38px 28px 0 #ff8066, 76px 2px 0 #f5c858, 104px 42px 0 #7dd8c7;
            top: 15%;
            right: 22%;
          }

          .pinball-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: minmax(220px, 0.38fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
            gap: 14px;
            flex: 1 1 auto;
            min-width: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
          }

          .pinball-notes,
          .pinball-board,
          .wokwi-shell {
            border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            background: #ffffff;
            box-sizing: border-box;
          }

          .pinball-notes {
            padding: 18px;
          }

          .pinball-notes h3,
          .wokwi-caption h3 {
            margin: 0 0 12px;
            color: #123a47;
            font-size: 20px;
            line-height: 1.15;
          }

          .pinball-notes dl {
            margin: 0;
            display: grid;
            gap: 12px;
          }

          .pinball-notes div {
            padding-bottom: 10px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #dce8e4;
          }

          .pinball-notes dt {
            color: #117168;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
          }

          .pinball-notes dd {
            margin: 4px 0 0;
            color: #34444d;
            font-size: 15px;
            line-height: 1.35;
          }

          .pinball-board {
            position: relative;
            min-height: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            background:
              linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(18, 58, 71, 0.16) 1px, transparent 1px),
              linear-gradient(35deg, rgba(18, 58, 71, 0.10) 1px, transparent 1px),
              #e7f1ed;
            background-size: 26px 26px, 26px 26px, auto;
          }

          .score-display {
            position: absolute;
            top: 24px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            padding: 10px 24px;
            border: 5px solid #183640;
            border-radius: 5px;
            background: #07191e;
            color: #f5c858;
            font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace;
            font-size: 30px;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            box-shadow: 0 5px 0 rgba(18, 58, 71, 0.20);
          }

          .target {
            position: absolute;
            width: 52px;
            height: 52px;
            border: 7px solid #e2553f;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: #f5c858;
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 7px #fff4ca, 0 4px 0 rgba(151, 49, 40, 0.20);
          }

          .target::after {
            content: '+100';
            position: absolute;
            top: 61px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            color: #a63d32;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 800;
            white-space: nowrap;
          }

          .target.one { top: 36%; left: 26%; }
          .target.two { top: 27%; left: 55%; }
          .target.three { top: 51%; right: 22%; }

          .flipper {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 54px;
            width: 130px;
            height: 24px;
            border: 0;
            border-radius: 24px;
            background: #e2553f;
            box-shadow: 0 5px 0 #9f362c;
          }

          .flipper.left { left: 25%; transform: rotate(23deg); transform-origin: left center; }
          .flipper.right { right: 25%; transform: rotate(-23deg); transform-origin: right center; }

          .board-label {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 20px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            color: #123a47;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
            white-space: nowrap;
          }

          .wokwi-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: minmax(225px, 0.34fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
            gap: 14px;
            flex: 1 1 auto;
            min-width: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
          }

          .wokwi-caption {
            padding: 18px;
            border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            background: #ffffff;
          }

          .wokwi-caption p {
            margin: 0 0 14px;
            color: #34444d;
            font-size: 15px;
            line-height: 1.42;
          }

          .wokwi-caption code {
            display: block;
            margin: 8px 0;
            padding: 7px 9px;
            overflow-wrap: anywhere;
            border-radius: 4px;
            background: #edf5f1;
            color: #123a47;
            font-size: 12px;
          }

          .wokwi-link {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 9px 12px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            background: #117168;
            color: #ffffff !important;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-decoration: none;
          }

          .wokwi-shell {
            min-height: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: #123a47;
          }

          .wokwi-shell iframe {
            display: block;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            min-height: 370px;
            border: 0;
            background: #ffffff;
          }

          .pin-map {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 10px;
            margin: 118px 20px 0;
          }

          .pin-map span {
            padding: 10px;
            border-left: 4px solid #f5c858;
            background: #edf5f1;
            color: #123a47;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: 700;
          }
          </style>
---

## 0.1 Inputs, Outputs, and Score {.content}

```{=html}
<div class="top-bar">0. PINBALL PROTOTYPE</div>
<div class="screenshot-row">
  <div class="pinball-layout">
    <div class="pinball-notes">
      <h3>Arduino Game Loop</h3>
      <dl>
        <div><dt>INPUTS</dt><dd>Two flipper buttons and three target switches use internal pull-up resistors.</dd></div>
        <div><dt>OUTPUTS</dt><dd>Two servos move the flippers. Three LEDs flash when a target scores.</dd></div>
        <div><dt>STATE</dt><dd>The score increases once per target hit and is reported in the serial monitor.</dd></div>
      </dl>
    </div>
    <div class="pinball-board" aria-label="Basic pinball layout">
      <div class="score-display">000000</div>
      <div class="target one"></div>
      <div class="target two"></div>
      <div class="target three"></div>
      <div class="flipper left"></div>
      <div class="flipper right"></div>
      <div class="board-label">FLIP • HIT • COUNT</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

## 0.2 Wokwi Arduino Simulation {.content}

```{=html}
<div class="top-bar">0. PINBALL PROTOTYPE</div>
<div class="screenshot-row">
  <div class="wokwi-grid">
    <div class="wokwi-caption">
      <h3>Live Simulator Embed</h3>
      <p>The embedded Arduino workspace keeps the simulation in the lesson. The deck-local Wokwi files define the pinball circuit and sketch.</p>
      <code>wokwi/sketch.ino</code>
      <code>wokwi/diagram.json</code>
      <p>Press either flipper switch to move a servo. Press a target switch to add 100 points and flash its LED.</p>
      <a class="wokwi-link" href="https://wokwi.com/projects/new/arduino-uno" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open in Wokwi</a>
    </div>
    <div class="wokwi-shell">
      <iframe src="https://wokwi.com/projects/new/arduino-uno?embed=1" title="Embedded Wokwi Arduino Uno simulator" loading="lazy" allow="fullscreen"></iframe>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

## 0.3 Pin Map {.content}

```{=html}
<div class="top-bar">0. PINBALL PROTOTYPE</div>
<div class="screenshot-row">
  <div class="pinball-layout">
    <div class="pinball-notes">
      <h3>Build Order</h3>
      <dl>
        <div><dt>1. ACTUATE</dt><dd>Attach each servo and confirm its resting and raised angles.</dd></div>
        <div><dt>2. DETECT</dt><dd>Wire target buttons to ground and read their transitions.</dd></div>
        <div><dt>3. RESPOND</dt><dd>Light an LED and update score only when a new hit is detected.</dd></div>
      </dl>
    </div>
    <div class="pinball-board">
      <div class="score-display">D2 D4 D5</div>
      <div class="pin-map">
        <span>D8 · Left flipper button</span>
        <span>D13 · Right flipper button</span>
        <span>D9 · Left servo</span>
        <span>D10 · Right servo</span>
        <span>D2 / D4 / D5 · Targets</span>
        <span>D3 / D11 / D12 · LEDs</span>
      </div>
      <div class="flipper left"></div>
      <div class="flipper right"></div>
      <div class="board-label">INPUTS ON THE LEFT · OUTPUTS ON THE RIGHT</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
